title: BENCHMARKING BIAS MITIGATION TOWARD FAIRNESS WITHOUT HARM FROM VISION TO LVLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation in vision models and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) using standard demographic parity and accuracy metrics.
